claim_scope: Primary-source evidence for GBMV2 scientific relevance, AM1-BCC compatibility, derivative support, implementation availability, and Route 1 admission. This is not a MAPLE runtime benchmark, an independent FreeSolv validation, a license opinion, or evidence that GBMV2 is faster than bare MM for small molecules.

gbmv2.name: Generalized Born with Molecular Volume, analytical method II, plus SASA

parameter_interface.charges: fixed atom-centered partial charges; GAFF/AM1-BCC demonstrated in the small-molecule studies
parameter_interface.intrinsic_radii: van der Waals radii by default; CHARMM WEIGHT can read user-supplied radii
parameter_interface.nonpolar: GBMV2 SASA coefficient SA (gamma) plus constant SB (beta)

published_force_support.gpu_cpu_energy_force_parity_scope: 22 small proteins; electrostatic and SASA energy/force parity in the 2020 implementation paper
important_limitations: The 2020 GPU force comparison is protein-focused, not a MAPLE small-molecule provider parity result.
The 2020 paper reports nonzero NVE drift and lower numerical stability than GBSW for the sharp molecular surface.
No local CHARMM or GBMV2 plugin was available for an all-3N finite-difference force gate.

knight_brooks_2011.interpretation: Strong historical multi-conformer evidence that a physical AM1-BCC/GBMV2/SASA profile can reduce typical hydration errors well below 3-5 kcal/mol. The tuned surface coefficient and historical dataset prevent treating these numbers as independent certification of the present MAPLE profile.
knight_brooks_2011.surface_tension_label_exposure: gamma was selected to minimize AUE on every tenth molecule after sorting the full set by experimental hydration free energy

vanommeslaeghe_et_al_2013.interpretation: The 375-molecule result is held out from selection of the GBMV2 surface coefficient on the 82 CGENFF compounds, but it is not a modern FreeSolv split or a MAPLE provider result.

overall_decision.reason: GBMV2 is the first audited remaining physical candidate with direct GAFF/AM1-BCC multi-conformer hydration evidence near 1.2 kcal/mol AUE and published analytical forces. Admission is blocked by the absence of a locally runnable, source-auditable, redistributable standalone provider. Reimplementing the CHARMM algorithm from the papers would violate the upstream-first/no-new-wheel rule and would not establish provider parity.
revisit_only_if: a registered local CHARMM/pyCHARMM GBMV2 runtime or a maintained redistributable standalone upstream implementation is available
the provider accepts the declared fixed AM1-BCC charges and audited intrinsic radii without changing the gas MLIP
the isolated solvent energy and complete solvent force can be obtained directly or by numerically exact solution-minus-vacuum cancellation
provider parity and full all-3N finite-difference force checks pass before OPT, SCAN, or MD
a prospectively frozen profile passes label-separated FreeSolv and multi-MLIP throughput gates
redistribution and deployment rights are established for the intended users

protocol.admission_rule: Promising published accuracy and analytical forces justify a high-priority provider audit, not integration. Route 1 requires a runnable upstream implementation, explicit parameter provenance, force parity, applicability, independent accuracy, and deployable license terms before product admission.
steps: freeze the small-molecule, force, GPU, official implementation, and registration sources
separate label-exposed published parameter selection from independent product validation
verify whether the public OpenMM distribution exposes GBMV2
probe the local runtime without obtaining credentials or accepting a license on the user behalf
reject paper-based reimplementation and leave the provider disabled until all revisit gates can be tested

paper_reported_gpu_plugin.reported_speedup_scope: about 60-70x versus one CPU core for 856-77304 atom proteins on a TITAN X Pascal

public_openmm.interpretation: The public OpenMM core is not the paper-reported CHARMM GBMV2 plugin. OpenMM being open source does not make the CHARMM plugin redistributable.
